what does a beta blocker do?
Beta blockers slow the heart rate and lower blood pressure. They block adrenaline at beta receptors, so the heart beats with less force.
why do we check potassium before giving digoxin?
Low potassium makes digoxin toxicity more likely. Check the level first, and hold the dose and tell the provider if it is low.
what's the difference between type 1 and type 2 diabetes?
In type 1, the body makes little or no insulin. In type 2, the body makes insulin but the cells respond poorly to it.

Gothic buildings use pointed arches, ribbed vaults and flying buttresses. These let walls be thinner and hold large stained glass windows.
Impressionism is a style that captures light and a passing moment with quick, visible brushstrokes. Painters often worked outdoors.
One-point perspective makes parallel lines meet at a single vanishing point on the horizon. It creates the look of depth on a flat surface.
Contrapposto is a pose where a figure puts its weight on one leg. The hips and shoulders tilt in opposite directions, so the body looks relaxed.
A still life is a picture of objects that don't move, such as fruit, flowers or cups. Artists use it to study light, texture and arrangement.
Iconography is the study of the symbols and figures in an image and what they mean. A key or a skull, for example, can carry a meaning viewers recognised.

what is a medium in art?
The medium is the material an artist works in, like oil paint, marble or ink. Each one limits and shapes what the artist can do.
what is consideration in a contract?
Consideration is something of value each side gives up. Without it, a promise is usually not enforceable as a contract.
what is the difference between an LLC and a corporation?
An LLC gives owners limited liability with flexible tax treatment. A corporation is a separate legal entity owned by shareholders, with more formal rules.
Promissory estoppel lets a court enforce a promise when someone relied on it and would be harmed. It fills the gap when there is no consideration.
A fiduciary duty is a duty to act in someone else's best interest. A company's directors, for example, must put the company ahead of their own gain.
A contract forms when one side makes an offer and the other accepts it on the same terms. A reply that changes the terms is a counteroffer, not an acceptance.
Negligence is a failure to take the care a reasonable person would take. The injured person has to show a duty, a breach of it, and harm the breach caused.
An agent acts for someone else, called the principal. What the agent agrees to within their authority binds the principal.
what happens when a contract is broken?
The usual remedy is money damages that put the other side where they would have been. A court orders the promise carried out only when money can't fix the harm.
Limited liability means owners can lose what they put into the business but not their personal assets. Creditors can only go after the business itself.
Dramatic irony is when the audience knows something a character does not. It builds tension because we watch the character act without that knowledge.
what is the theme of Hamlet?
Hamlet explores revenge, doubt and how hard it is to act. The prince keeps delaying, and that delay drives the tragedy.
An unreliable narrator tells the story in a way we can't fully trust. Their bias, gaps or mistakes make the reader question what really happened.
Foreshadowing is a hint early in a story about what will happen later. It builds suspense and makes the ending feel earned.
A motif is an image, idea or phrase that comes back again and again in a work. Each time it returns, it adds to the larger meaning.
Free verse is poetry without a set rhyme scheme or regular meter. It follows the rhythm of natural speech instead.
what is the climax of a story?
The climax is the turning point, where the main conflict reaches its highest tension. After it, the story moves toward its resolution.
The protagonist is the main character, the one the story follows. Their goals and struggles drive the plot.
what does tone mean in literature?
Tone is the writer's attitude toward the subject or the reader. Word choice, rhythm and detail all shape whether it feels playful, bitter or calm.
Recursion is when a function calls itself on a smaller version of the problem. Each call needs a base case, or it never stops.
Big O describes how running time grows as the input grows. For example, a loop over n items is O(n).
A hash table stores key and value pairs. A hash function turns each key into an index, so lookups are fast on average.
Binary search checks the middle item of a sorted list. If the target is smaller, it searches the left half; otherwise, the right half. It repeats until it finds the item.
what is a python list comprehension?
A list comprehension builds a list in one line, like [x * 2 for x in nums]. Python reads it left to right.
